newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian copper tracks global trend, ends down.
newsitem.headline: Indian copper tracks global trend, ends down.

text.p: Copper prices eased on Monday while other base metals were steady, traders said.
Copper slid by 25 rupees at 13,850 rupees per quintal on sluggish industrial demand even as a weak trend in the world market prompted offerings, they said.
Copper was down by 25 rupees on Saturday.
Tin and nickel were steady at the reduced level amid limited inflow and limited industrial demand.
Tin was quiet at 29,600 rupees per quintal after losing 500 rupees last week. Nickel was steady at 34,300 rupees per quintal after losing 500 rupees last week.

Aluminium was steady at 7,700 rupees, so was zinc at 8,150 rupees and lead at 4,125 rupees per quintal amid nominal trading. Lead was up by 25 rupees per quintal on Saturday following firm trend in the world market.
